title: Pulse Drift
summary: A drift game anchored by pulse notes and timing-based survival.
instructions: Press Space as the pulse notes cross the marker line.

overlay.startCopy: A rhythm lane game driven by a looping beat chart. Hit the pulses on time to build the run.

help.title: How To Start
steps: Press Start Drift in the center overlay.
Watch the beat line and learn the loop timing.
Press Space as the pulse notes cross the marker line.
Keep the rhythm going to build score.
tips: Focus on the marker line rather than the moving notes.
Missing one note lowers the run quality.

onboarding.title: Rhythm Setup
startSteps: Open Help to review the marker line.
Press Start Drift to start the track.
Tap Space as the first note crosses the target.
onboarding.firstGoal: Land the first beat and keep the loop alive.
